$comment: GENERATED by `cargo run -p deck-space --features schema --bin deck-schema` from deck-space's SceneDocument (scene_document.rs) – do not edit.

map.description:
an audio link's channel map (plan 2.6, #318): `[source, target]` pairs counted from 1 – `[[1, 3], [2, 4]]` lands a
stereo source on channels 3 and 4 (a send's offset); one source may go to several targets, several sources into one
target sum. Empty = channel n to channel n. `scale` on an audio link is the send level.

Look.description: The scene's `[being]` table – the body's shape (the colours are the space node's inputs).

breath.description: how much its slow breath swells it (a fraction of its size)

character.description: the head's character (its portrait sprites `<character>_portrait-<mood>`); empty = a head without a face

drift.description: how far it floats around its spot (m)

expose.description:
the parameters shown as buttons: "node" (all its inputs) or "node.port"; empty = every control input
  – or a counted group `"seq.step1..16 <= seq.steps"` (#424, params.rs `Expose`): the first N of those knobs, N = the
  value of `seq.steps` now. The list's order is the knobs' order on a node (the first named hangs nearest its point).

moods.description: the moods the energy walks through, calm → wild (default MOODS)

wobble.description: each point's own small sway (a fraction of the size)

Nudge.description: One `[[being.react]]` nudge as the scene writes it.

input.description:
an unlinked control input, `node.port` (by id, else by kind). Was `set` until #243 (SCENES.md §8.2: in a scene `set`
is the staging only); the repo's scenes were migrated, no alias (RULES E2)

Rule.description: One `[[being.feel]]` rule as the scene writes it.

chance.description: 0..1: the odds that it fires when its test comes true

for.description: seconds the test must hold before the rule fires

when.description: the source: `node.port` (the node by id, else the first of that kind), `bpm`, `touch`, `energy`, `phrase`

SceneTransition.description: What a switch does to the outputs (the lamps) between two scenes (#264).

oneOf.description: hold the last values, then crossfade to the new scene's over `transition_secs`; channels it doesn't drive fade to 0
the new scene takes over at once; channels it doesn't drive go to 0
the lamps go dark first (the outputs stop and start again), like a stop

audio_buffer.description:
the audio device's buffer in frames (#208, deck-native's audio/backend.rs): a heavy scene may ask for more;
`--audio-buffer` and deck.toml's `audio_buffer` (the machine's) win over it. None = the device's default

render_scale.description: the render size relative to the window (0.25–1); a software adapter halves it by itself

transition.description:
how the stage hands over TO this scene on a switch (F5, #264): the DMX / MIDI outputs of the scene that was playing
fade into this one's (`fade`, the default), snap (`cut`) or go dark first (`blackout`); a stop is always dark

transition_secs.description: the hand-over's length in s (`fade`); the same time base as the picture's fade in (deck-native switcher.rs `FADE_IN`)

description:
One `scene:<id>` document as the API stores it: the header, then the scene's own fields at the top level
(`stage`, `node`, `link`, `outputs`, `being`).

format.description: the document's format: 1 (today's scene graph, no holders)

id.description: the key's id: `nave` for `scene:nave` – platform-wide, no toon in it (a scene can serve several toons and shows)

outputs.description:
the parameters as outputs (#211) – MIDI out, the conductor, DMX fixtures and the clock-synced strobe; parsed and
checked by deck-outputs (its config.rs documents the table), played by the host (deck-native's outputs.rs)

toons.description: the toons whose address books list it; empty = reachable by its id only (proposal, SCENES.md §7 question 5)

version.description: the number the server stamps on every change (as a show's); absent until the first save

title: SceneDocument
